name: Thin high-cloud sky
description: Thin high-cloud sky is a conceptual setting for vehicles; architecture. It combines the specified surroundings with independently managed lighting.
scope: Finite original context geometry, a separate HDR/EXR illumination field and a camera-only authored backplate. Sun energy is kept outside the HDR to prevent duplicate solar illumination.
preview_scope: Actual SolidCraft modelling/product viewport snapshot. It does not apply the saved HDR/path-traced lighting.
limitations: Sky/weather radiance is an artistic analytic field, not a calibrated atmosphere. Optional rain/snow/fog intent is retained separately.
Procedural family realization with named contextual components; no claim that every physical detail of the concept has been modeled or validated.
Native glTF import retains geometry and scalar appearances, not arbitrary material extensions or textures.
